text:
Alex G: Heads-up — hitting a docs vs SDK mismatch for PATCH /v1/models/:id/rollout. The API schema lists 'n_candidates' but all existing examples and the Python/JS snippets use 'num_candidates'. Support is seeing 400s.
Maya R: ugh, thanks for flagging. Do we know which is the source-of-truth? server logs or swagger?
Alex G: Server expects 'num_candidates' (confirmed from infra logs). The openapi schema file under api-specs/models.yaml was updated months ago but looks like someone renamed the example only.
Liam S: I can open a small docs PR to standardize examples to 'num_candidates' and add a note in the migration guide. Prefer not to change runtime aliasing.
Maya R: +1 to standardize on 'num_candidates'. But we should also make the schema accept the old key for one release so clients don't break. Can we add a tolerant request example or a server alias?
Liam S: I'll cc eng-runtime for the alias option. For docs side: change schema examples, update Python/JS snippets, and add a short migration blurb (what to change and timeline).
DocsBot: Suggested PR template snippet for this kind of change:
```
- Fix: API reference examples (PATCH /v1/models/:id/rollout) — use 'num_candidates' consistently
- Backcompat: add note + server will accept 'n_candidates' through 2027-06-01
- Tests: add example to docs unit tests; add cURL samples for both keys
- SDK: coordinate with eng-platform to add alias mapping in clients
```
Maya R: Can you also update the example response block? Current example response shows a field 'candidate_count' (int) but runtime returns 'candidates' array with length, so that should be corrected.
Alex G: Good catch. Example currently:
```
200 OK
{
  "status": "rolling",
  "candidate_count": 5
}
```
But actual runtime response is:
```
200 OK
{
  "status": "rolling",
  "candidates": [ { "id": "v1", "weight": 0.6 }, { "id": "v2", "weight": 0.4 } ]
}
```
Liam S: I'll include both in the PR: canonical response + note that older clients may still parse candidate_count (we'll map it server-side).
Maya R: Who owns the SDK snippets? I can update the docs snippets, but we need eng-platform to push the client alias so examples don't diverge again. @Liam S can you loop them in?
Liam S: Yup — pinging eng-platform@redwood (cc'ed in the PR). Also adding a tiny test in docs/unit that validates the example request/response shape against the openapi schema.
DocsBot: Quick checklist for reviewers: small schema/examples change, include CHANGES.md entry, add a tiny integration test, coordinate SDK release notes.
Alex G: Thanks — assigned to Liam. Once the PR is up please drop a link here and I'll sanity-check the snippets in our JS sample app. :thumbsup:
Maya R: ETA?
Liam S: I can file the PR in ~30m and aim for review today. If eng-runtime can't add the alias soon, we'll update the migration note timeline.
Alex G: Perfect. I'll update the support thread with a short note so folks know a fix is incoming.
DocsBot: Noted — will auto-add the PR link when detected.
